name: Clipboard+
description:
Clipboard+ is a minimal, beautiful clipboard manager with clipboard history for GNOME. Copy and paste text, images, screenshots, links, colors, code and files again later.

* Instant search with smart filters
* Large preview card: Space enlarges it or opens links
* Pin, edit and tag entries
* Show screenshots and copied files in their folder
* Private mode and excluded apps (password managers)
* Four layouts, light and dark styles, system accent color
* Subtle sounds and animations, both optional
* Available in 18 languages

Open it with Alt+C (configurable) or from the top bar.

Clipboard access: this extension reads the clipboard to keep a history. The history stays on your computer and is never sent anywhere.

Event-driven (no polling) for near-zero battery usage. Made by Dukha.
